name: Helm OCI charts
auth: READ permission is required to resolve metadata and bytes; DEPLOY is additionally required to publish. Supply an unexpired Access token in AW_TOKEN; Basic authentication uses AW_USER matching the token subject. Token scope must retain the repository permissions; a token cannot grant access that its principal lacks.
fresh_home: Set all HELM_* directories to AW_WORK. Seed the selected authority in the isolated registry file to prevent automatic host-keychain selection.
prerequisites: HTTPS registry; an existing helmoci repository.
A chart directory acme/ with version 0.1.0.

configure.code:
umask 077
AW_WORK=$(mktemp -d)
export HELM_CONFIG_HOME="$AW_WORK/config"
export HELM_CACHE_HOME="$AW_WORK/cache"
export HELM_DATA_HOME="$AW_WORK/data"
export HELM_REGISTRY_CONFIG="$AW_WORK/config/registry/config.json"
mkdir -p "$AW_WORK/config/registry"
configure.note: Use a fresh configuration and cache for every independent connection check.

configure.code:
AW_REGISTRY="${AW_URL#*://}"
export AW_REGISTRY
python3 - <<'PY'
import json, os
from pathlib import Path
Path(os.environ["HELM_REGISTRY_CONFIG"]).write_text(json.dumps({"auths": {os.environ["AW_REGISTRY"]: {}}}))
PY
helm registry login "$AW_REGISTRY" --username "$AW_USER" --password "$AW_TOKEN"

publish.note: Publish to the OCI namespace of a local or one-node federated repository.

steps.code:
helm package acme --version 0.1.0
helm push acme-0.1.0.tgz "oci://$AW_REGISTRY/$AW_REPO"

install.note: The chart name is appended after the repository key.

limitations: Strict tag overwrite may require DELETE when an existing chart version changes.
JFrog CLI can wrap helm push to record build-info; configure its isolated home as in the generic recipe and add --build-name/--build-number.
The client uses oci://authority/repository, not the classic /artifactory/api/helm path.

contains: Helm pulls an OCI chart through the remote
